summary: A feed producer has appointed a new Vice President to lead its Asian division operations. The appointment reflects the company's focus on expanding its presence in the region's aquaculture market.
title: Feed producer appoints new VP for Asian division
title_en: Feed producer appoints new VP for Asian division

summary: BioMar has launched a new hatchery research and development facility to advance its aquaculture feed development capabilities. The investment demonstrates the company's commitment to innovation in early-stage fish nutrition and breeding research infrastructure.
title: BioMar launches new hatchery research and development facility
title_en: BioMar launches new hatchery research and development facility

summary: BioMar Vietnam appointed Duong Anh Tu as managing director as part of broader leadership changes in the aquaculture sector. Tom Johan Austrheim was named CFO of Nordic Aqua Partners in a separate announcement reported by SeafoodSource on the same date.
title: Tom Johan Austrheim named Nordic Aqua Partners CFO; BioMar Vietnam appoints Duong Anh Tu as managing director
title_en: Tom Johan Austrheim named Nordic Aqua Partners CFO; BioMar Vietnam appoints Duong Anh Tu as managing director

summary: BioMar has introduced a new additive designed to reduce stress in farmed fish. The product represents the company's continued innovation in aquaculture feed solutions for salmon production systems.
title: BioMar lanza nuevo aditivo para reducir el estrés en peces
title_en: BioMar lanza nuevo aditivo para reducir el estrés en peces

summary: BioMar has opened a new facility or division in Hirtshals, Denmark. The expansion represents growth for the aquaculture feed producer.

title_en: Biomar åpnet ny avdeling i Hirtshals

summary: BioMar has launched a new product specifically formulated to help manage stress in farmed salmon and enhance their performance. The product addresses key welfare and productivity challenges in aquaculture operations.
title: BioMar’s new product helps manage salmon stress and improve performance
title_en: BioMar’s new product helps manage salmon stress and improve performance
